ch02-variables-and-types#6.why: A String put into an int variable. The error message is the lesson.

ch02-variables-and-types#13.noCheck: Any book is right, so this one has no Check: run it and read the sentence it prints.

ch02-variables-and-types#17.why: This program divides a String by a number, which javac refuses. Fixing it is the exercise.

ch03-expressions-and-operators#14.compileError: bad operand types for binary operator '<='
ch03-expressions-and-operators#14.why: A range written the way it is on paper, which Java refuses. The error message is the lesson.

ch04-making-decisions#9.compileError: incompatible types: String cannot be converted to boolean
ch04-making-decisions#9.why: A String used as a condition, which javac refuses. The error message is the lesson.

ch05-repetition#22.why: The secret number is random, so each run picks its own: your game will not match the sample run under the program.

ch06-methods#7.compileError: incompatible types: void cannot be converted to int
ch06-methods#7.why: A void method's result stored in a variable, which javac refuses. The error message is the lesson.

ch06-methods#11.why: A variable used outside the method that created it, which javac refuses. The error message is the lesson.

ch07-arrays-and-lists#2.compileError: incompatible types: String cannot be converted to int
ch07-arrays-and-lists#2.why: An int array given a String, which javac refuses. The error message is the lesson.

ch07-arrays-and-lists#4.why: Java has no negative indexes, so index -1 does not exist and the program stops. The exception is the lesson.

ch07-arrays-and-lists#5.why: The array has two items, so index 5 does not exist and the program stops. The exception is the lesson.

ch07-arrays-and-lists#17.compileError: incompatible types: void cannot be converted to ArrayList<Integer>
ch07-arrays-and-lists#17.why: What Collections.sort gives back is stored in a variable, which javac refuses: it gives back nothing. The error message is the lesson.

ch08-strings-as-data#2.why: One character of a String is assigned to, which javac refuses: a String cannot be changed. The error message is the lesson.

ch09-maps-and-sets#14.why: Set.of and Map.of promise no order, and the JDK picks a new one each time a program starts, so a run may print these items in another order than the one shown.

ch10-records#2.compileError: cannot assign a value to final variable score
ch10-records#2.why: A record's component is assigned to, which javac refuses: a record cannot be changed. The error message is the lesson.
